quarterly_data.signal: Southern Company's second-quarter 2026 earnings release kilowatt-hour sales table: total sales of 51,793 million kWh in the three months ended June 2026 versus 49,858 million (+3.9%), including total wholesale sales of 13,826 million kWh versus 12,664 million (+9.2%); year-to-date June total sales were 101,985 million kWh (+3.7%) and total wholesale sales 27,417 million kWh (+11.0%).
